name: AnonX Music
description: A Telegram Music Player Bot, written in Python with Pyrogram and Py-Tgcalls.

POT_BASE_URL.description: Optional URL of a bgutil-ytdlp-pot-provider server (e.g. on Koyeb). When set, yt-dlp fetches PO tokens from it to avoid YouTube bot checks on datacenter IPs.

MONGO_URL.description: Get a mongodb url from https://cloud.mongodb.com.

LOGGER_ID.description: Your log group ID, add your bot there and promote as an admin.

OWNER_ID.description: The user id of user whom you would like to add as OWNER.

SESSION.description: A Pyrogram v2 String Session from @StringFatherBot on Telegram.

SUPPORT_CHANNEL.description: Telegram updates channel URL, username, or numeric chat ID. For private IDs, the bot must be admin with invite link permission.

SUPPORT_CHAT.description: Telegram support group URL, username, or numeric chat ID. For private IDs, the bot must be admin with invite link permission.

API_URL.description: Optional YouTube download API base URL used as a fallback when yt-dlp fails.

API_KEY.description: Optional API key for the YouTube download API fallback.

COOKIES_URL.description: Optional space-separated batbin.me URL(s) with YouTube cookies, used when playback needs cookies.
